changelog_text:
Adds HUD colours and a staging list you can read and rearrange in flight.

- **HUD colour.** **Mods → ModernUI colour** draws the whole HUD in amber, orange, cyan, green or pink instead of white. It is saved in `settings.json`.
- **See what each stage fires.** Each stage lists its actions as chips: engines with their fuel, decouplers and parachutes. Hover a chip to light its parts on the vessel and see its name. Closed, the staging header still shows what the next stage fires.
- **Restage in flight.** Drag a chip to another stage, or drag a stage by its name to reorder. Both go through the game's own staging code, as the stock panel's drags do. Stages that have already fired can't be changed.
- **Long staging lists scroll.** The open list is about six stages tall. Strips above and below name the hidden stages; click one or use the mouse wheel, and hold a dragged chip over a strip to scroll to a hidden stage. Before, stages past the eighth were hidden with no sign, and a long list pushed the crew card over the rings.
- **Unnamed parts get names.** Parts the game leaves unnamed are named from their tags (escape tower, interstellar drive, heatshield, interstage, service module).

![Staging: hover an action, drag it to another stage, drag a stage to reorder](https://github.com/ericnondahl/ModernUI/blob/main/images/staging.jpg?raw=true)

**Install:** unzip `ModernUI.zip` into your mods folder (you get `mods/ModernUI/`), enable ModernUI, and start the game through StarMap. Or install it with Borea: find ModernUI in Discover.

**Dependencies:** [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap) 0.5.4 or later (Borea installs it for you). Built for KSA 2026.11.25.5949. Tested on Windows and macOS (the community Mac port); Linux untested so far.

**License:** MIT (see LICENSE). The bundled [Barlow](https://github.com/jpt/barlow) fonts (version 1.408) are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; their license and the other notices are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, in the zip and the repository.

listing.name: ModernUI
listing.abstract: A launch-webcast style flight HUD that replaces every stock flight gauge
listing.description:
# ModernUI

A flight HUD in the style of a launch webcast: flat, black and white, thin rings and big
numbers. It replaces every stock flight gauge, controls included, and stays out of the way
when nothing needs you.

![ModernUI in flight](ksa-image:Flight)

- **Rings** for speed (filling towards orbit) and altitude; apoapsis and periapsis with
  warp-to.
- **A line-drawn navball** with every marker, heading, pitch, roll and their rates.
- **Engine deck**: delta-v, TWR, stage; ignite, shutdown, stage, RCS.
- **Staging list** with each stage's delta-v, TWR, Isp and burn time, and what it fires
  (engines with their fuel, decouplers, parachutes). Drag an action to another stage, or a
  stage to reorder, in flight.
- **Crew as wireframe cats**, with life support, power, radiation, and every vessel's next
  crew deadline.
- **Autopilot**, **burn control**, a **map-view burn editor**, a **target card**, and EVA
  controls.
- **Three modes** (P): CLEAN (the webcast look), FLIGHT (panels fold to short headers), FULL.
- **Six colours**: white, amber, orange, cyan, green or pink (Mods → ModernUI colour).

Every control does what the stock button does, through the same game code.

![Staging: hover an action to see it on the rocket, drag it to another stage, drag a stage to reorder](ksa-image:Staging)

![The HUD in each colour: white, amber, orange, cyan, green, pink](ksa-image:Colours)

![Ascent in CLEAN mode](ksa-image:Clean)

![Autopilot in orbit](ksa-image:Autopilot)

![Burn editor in map view](ksa-image:BurnEditor)

![EVA](ksa-image:Eva)

Tested on Windows and macOS (the community Mac port); reports from Linux are welcome.
